story.title: Google's $15B AI Data Centre in Visakhapatnam to Make India a Premier AI Hub in Asia
story.summary: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu will officially unveil Google's $15 billion AI data centre project in Visakhapatnam on April 28, 2026. The facility will carry a capacity of 1 gigawatt, one of the largest single AI infrastructure investments ever announced in Asia. The project is positioned to transform Visakhapatnam into a technology and AI hub with significant implications for jobs, digital infrastructure, and India's standing in the global AI race.
